questions.question: What is the theme of Vigilance Awareness Week 2025 observed by the Central Vigilance Commission (CVC)?

options.text: Integrity for Progress: Building a Corruption-Free Nation
Transparency in Action: Towards Good Governance
Ethics First: Empowering Citizens Against Corruption

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Vigilance: Our Shared Responsibility.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Central Vigilance Commission (CVC) observed Vigilance Awareness Week 2025 from October 27 to November 2 under the theme “Vigilance: Our Shared Responsibility.”**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Vigilance Awareness Week 2025** was observed from **October 27 to November 2** across India.
 
• The theme for 2025 was **“Vigilance: Our Shared Responsibility.”**
 
• The campaign aimed to foster **ethics, transparency, and citizen participation** in fighting corruption.
 
• A **three-month pre-event campaign (August 18–November 17)** focused on **preventive vigilance** across five key governance areas.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Central Vigilance Commission (CVC)**__

 __
 
• Established in **1964** based on the recommendations of the **Santhanam Committee**.
 
• Became a **statutory body in 2003** under the **CVC Act, 2003**.
 
• Functions as an **independent body**, not under any ministry, and is responsible to **Parliament** for promoting integrity in governance.
 
• Comprises a **Central Vigilance Commissioner** and up to **two Vigilance Commissioners**.
 
 
 
• **Wings of CVC**__
 __
 
• **Chief Technical Examiner’s (CTE) Wing** – Examines technical and civil works for transparency.
 
• **Commission for Departmental Inquiries (CDI) Wing** – Handles disciplinary cases against public officials.
 
• **Secretariat** – Supports administrative and operational functions.
 
 
 
• **Objective of Vigilance Awareness Week**__
 
 
• Promote **integrity, accountability, and transparency** in public administration.

questions.question: Which command of the Indian Army conducted the large-scale drone and counter-drone exercise Vayu Samanvay-II in the desert sector in November 2025?

questions.question: Which country has recently formally joined the Abraham Accords, a series of normalisation agreements between Israel and Arab nations brokered by the United States? (Nov 2025)
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Kazakhstan.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The US President confirmed that Kazakhstan has formally joined the Abraham Accords, expanding the circle of Middle Eastern and Central Asian nations normalising relations with Israel.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The Abraham Accords are a set of normalisation agreements signed in 2020 between Israel and several Arab countries, mediated by the United States.
 
• They marked a significant shift in Middle East diplomacy by establishing relations with Israel without prior resolution of the Israel–Palestine conflict.
 
• The accords initially included Israel, UAE, Bahrain, Sudan, and Morocco; Kazakhstan has now become the latest nation to join.
 
• The agreements promote economic, technological, and security partnerships while strengthening U.S. strategic influence in the region.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Background of the Abraham Accords**__

 __
 
• Brokered by the U.S. administration under President Donald Trump in 2020.
 
• Aimed at normalising diplomatic, economic, and cultural relations between Israel and Arab states.
 
• Named after Abraham, a patriarchal figure common to Judaism, Christianity, and Islam.
 
 
 
• **Member Countries (as of 2025)**__
 __
 
• Israel
 
• United Arab Emirates (UAE)
 
• Bahrain
 
• Sudan
 
• Morocco
 
• Kazakhstan (new entrant)
 
 
 
• **Impact of the Accords**__
 __
 
• Reduced Israel’s regional isolation and improved Arab–Israeli cooperation.
 
• Boosted trade, investment, and technological collaboration in defence, energy, and innovation sectors.
 
• Created a new model for peace without preconditions related to the Palestinian issue.
 
 
 
• **UAE’s Role**__
 __
 
• First Gulf country to normalise relations with Israel under the Abraham Accords in 2020.
 
• Set the precedent for other nations to follow, encouraging greater diplomatic engagement with Israel.
 
 
 
• **Strategic Importance for the U.S.**__

questions.question: Which medical equipment’s mandatory requirement has been removed under the 2025 amendment to the Transplantation of Human Organs and Tissues Rules to improve access to corneal transplantation services?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Clinical Specular Microscope.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The **Union Ministry of Health and Family Welfare** amended the **Transplantation of Human Organs and Tissues (Amendment) Rules, 2025** under the 1994 Act to streamline and strengthen the **National Organ Transplant Programme (NOTP)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The amendment removes the **mandatory use of the Clinical Specular Microscope** in corneal transplantation centres.
 
• This device was previously required for assessing corneal endothelial cell health.
 
• The change aims to make **eye donation and corneal transplantation services** more accessible nationwide.
 
• The decision supports greater participation of smaller medical centres and NGOs involved in eye banking and transplant services.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **About the Transplantation of Human Organs and Tissues Act, 1994**__

 __
 
• Provides legal framework for the **removal, storage, and transplantation** of human organs and tissues.
 
• Regulates organ donation and prevents commercial dealings in human organs.
 
 
 
• **About the Cornea**__
 __
 
• The **transparent, dome-shaped outer layer** of the eye that helps focus light on the retina.
 
• Damage or disease in the cornea can cause severe **vision impairment or blindness**.
 
 
 
• **National Organ Transplant Programme (NOTP)**__
 
 
• Launched by the Ministry of Health to promote organ donation and streamline transplantation processes.
 
• Aims to ensure **equitable access** to organ and tissue transplant services across India.

questions.question: A tragic blast occurred in a moving car on November 10, 2025, killing at least 13 people and injuring several others. The explosion took place near which historical monument in New Delhi?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Red Fort.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• A powerful blast occurred on **November 10, 2025**, in a **Hyundai i20 car** parked near **Gate No. 1 of the Red Fort Metro Station** in New Delhi.
 
• The explosion took place close to the **Red Fort**, one of India’s most iconic historical monuments and a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
 
• The blast claimed the lives of **13 people** and injured several others, leading to an immediate lockdown of the area.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Location:** Near **Red Fort Metro Station** (Gate No. 1), adjacent to the Red Fort complex.
 
• **Date of Incident:** November 10, 2025 (Monday evening).
 
• **Fatalities:** 13 people confirmed dead; several injured.
 
• **Agencies Involved in Probe:** Delhi Police, NIA, NSG, and Forensic Science Laboratory (FSL).
 
• **Case Registered Under:** *Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act (UAPA)* and the *Explosives Act*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**, while on a visit to Bhutan, called the blast part of a “**conspiracy**” and assured that all those responsible would be brought to justice.
 
• **Union Home Minister Amit Shah** convened a high-level security meeting to review the situation.
 
• **Red Fort** and its metro station were temporarily closed for **three days (Nov 11–13)** for security and investigation.
 
• **Security Status:** States including Haryana, Punjab, Himachal Pradesh, Karnataka, and Jammu & Kashmir were placed on high alert following the blast.
 
• **Suspected Links:** Early probe suggested possible connections with a **Faridabad terror module** where explosives were previously seized.

**Significance:** The incident near the Red Fort — a national symbol where India’s Independence Day is celebrated annually — has raised serious security concerns across major urban centers in India.

questions.question: The Employees’ Enrolment Scheme – 2025, launched to promote voluntary EPF compliance and extend social security coverage, was introduced under which Union Ministry?

options.text: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Labour & Employment.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Union Minister for Labour & Employment and Youth Affairs & Sports, Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya, launched the Employees’ Enrolment Scheme – 2025 at EPFO’s 73rd Foundation Day in New Delhi.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Launched by:** Ministry of Labour & Employment under Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya.
 
• **Scheme Duration:** Open from 1 November 2025 to 30 April 2026.
 
• **Coverage:** For employees left out of EPF coverage between 1 July 2017 and 31 October 2025.
 
• **Objective:** Promote voluntary compliance and ensure universal EPF inclusion to strengthen “Social Security for All.”

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Employees’ Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO)**__

 __
 
• Established: 1952 under the Employees’ Provident Funds and Miscellaneous Provisions Act, 1952.
 
• Function: Provides retirement benefits and social security to India’s organized workforce.
 
• Administrative Authority: Ministry of Labour & Employment.
 
 
 
• **Scheme Features**__
 __
 
• Waiver of employee’s share for non-deducted periods.
 
• Employer’s liability limited to employer’s share, interest, admin charges, and ₹100 penal damages.
 
• Applicable to all establishments regardless of existing EPF coverage.
 
 
 
• **Relevant Legal Provisions**__
 
 
• Section 7A – Determination of money due from employers.
 
• Para 26B – Membership of Employees’ Pension Scheme (EPS-1995).
 
• Para 8 – Administrative provisions for EPS-1995.

questions.question: Who has been awarded the Manohar Parrikar Yuva Scientist Award 2025, instituted by the Government of Goa to honour outstanding young Indian researchers in science and technology?

questions.question: World Radiography Day 2025, observed on November 8, commemorates the discovery of X-rays. Who discovered X-rays, laying the foundation for modern diagnostic imaging?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Wilhelm Conrad Roentgen.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• World Radiography Day 2025 was observed on November 8 to celebrate the discovery of X-rays and recognize the contributions of radiographers and radiologists to healthcare and diagnostic medicine.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• X-rays were discovered by German physicist Wilhelm Conrad Roentgen on November 8, 1895, at the University of Würzburg.
 
• His discovery revolutionized medical imaging and diagnostics, allowing physicians to see inside the human body without surgery.
 
• In recognition of his contribution, Roentgen received the first-ever Nobel Prize in Physics in 1901.
 
• The 2025 theme for World Radiography Day is "Radiographers: Seeing the Unseen," highlighting the crucial role of radiographers in detecting and diagnosing diseases.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **About Wilhelm Conrad Roentgen**__

 __
 
• Born: March 27, 1845, in Lennep, Germany.
 
• Discovered X-rays in 1895 while experimenting with cathode rays.
 
• Awarded the first Nobel Prize in Physics in 1901 for his discovery.
 
• X-rays were initially called “Roentgen rays” in his honor.
 
 
 
• **About World Radiography Day**__
 __
 
• Observed annually on November 8, marking the anniversary of X-ray discovery.
 
• Officially designated by the International Society of Radiographers and Radiological Technologists (ISRRT) in 2007.
 
• Aims to raise awareness about radiation safety, radiologic technology, and the contributions of imaging professionals.
 
 
 
• **Significance of X-rays**__
 __
 
• Revolutionized diagnosis and treatment in modern medicine.
 
• Formed the basis of various imaging techniques like CT scans, fluoroscopy, and mammography.
 
• Enabled early disease detection, trauma assessment, and guided surgical procedures.
 
 
 
• **World Radiography Day 2025 Theme**__
 __
 
• Theme: “Radiographers: Seeing the Unseen.”
 
• Focuses on the indispensable role of radiographers in uncovering hidden medical conditions and ensuring accurate diagnosis.
 
 
 
• **Quick Facts**__
 
 
• Discovery of X-rays: November 8, 1895.
 
• Discovered by: Wilhelm Conrad Roentgen.
 
• First Nobel Prize in Physics: 1901 (awarded to Roentgen).
 
• Instituted by: International Society of Radiographers and Radiological Technologists (ISRRT) in 2007.

• He assumed charge as the __Controller General of Defence Accounts (CGDA)__ on 1st November 2025.
 
• He has over three decades of experience in defence finance, public administration, and financial management.
 
• He has served in key roles including Additional Secretary & Financial Adviser, Department of Science & Technology, and Joint Secretary, Department of Heavy Industry.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Controller General of Defence Accounts (CGDA):**__ The apex authority of the Defence Accounts Department responsible for audit, accounting, and financial advice for the Ministry of Defence.
 
• __**Indian Defence Accounts Service (IDAS):**__ A Group ‘A’ Central Civil Service under the Ministry of Defence managing the finances of the Armed Forces.
 
• __**Defence Accounts Department (DAD):**__ Provides financial management support to the defence services, including pay, pensions, procurement, and audit functions.
 
• __**Training and International Exposure:**__ Shri Sahay has represented India at prestigious institutions such as Cambridge University (UK) and the George C. Marshall European Centre for Security Studies (Germany).

questions.question: Which upcoming wildlife survey in India, scheduled for 2026, is known as the world’s largest and most advanced wildlife census, integrating satellite mapping, AI-driven camera traps, and field tracking to assess tiger populations and ecosystem health?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**All India Tiger Estimation (AITE).**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• India is preparing for the 2026 All India Tiger Estimation (AITE), the world’s largest and most sophisticated wildlife survey, aimed at assessing tiger populations and overall ecosystem health.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The All India Tiger Estimation (AITE) is conducted once every four years and integrates **ground tracking, satellite mapping, and AI-based camera traps** for data collection and analysis.
 
• India, which harbors over **75% of the world’s wild tigers**, recorded 3,682 tigers in the 2022 census.
 
• The 2026 survey will cover over **400,000 sq km** of forest area across 20+ states, involving **more than 60,000 forest staff**.
 
• The Wildlife Institute of India (WII) and the National Tiger Conservation Authority (NTCA) are leading the scientific and technological aspects of the survey.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Three Phases of AITE 2026**__

 __
 
• **Phase 1 – On-Ground Tracking:** Forest guards patrol 15 km daily, documenting pugmarks, prey sightings, and human activity to assess habitat health.
 
• **Phase 2 – Satellite Integration:** The Wildlife Institute of India uses remote sensing to map forest cover, water sources, and human encroachment for targeted conservation.
 
• **Phase 3 – Camera Traps & AI:** Over 40,000 motion-sensitive cameras will capture tiger images, with AI software identifying individuals through unique stripe patterns.
 
 
 
• **Technological Innovations**__
 __
 
• Combines field data, GIS mapping, and artificial intelligence for precise estimation.
 
• Ensures optimal camera placement through satellite-guided habitat mapping.
 
• Uses advanced analytics to monitor prey density and human-wildlife interfaces.
 
 
 
• **Conservation Impact**__
 __
 
• Helps measure India’s progress toward its **net-zero biodiversity loss goals**.
 
• Guides policies for tiger conservation, habitat restoration, and eco-tourism planning.
 
• Strengthens India’s global leadership in wildlife conservation science.
 
 
 
• **Static Facts**__
 
 
• Survey Name: All India Tiger Estimation (AITE)
 
• Next Census: 2026
 
• Previous Count (2022): 3,682 tigers
 
• Coverage Area: 400,000 sq km
 
• Lead Agency: Wildlife Institute of India (WII)
 
• Collaborating Body: National Tiger Conservation Authority (NTCA)

questions.question: Which Indian bank has achieved the historic dual milestone of crossing $100 billion in market capitalisation and ₹100 trillion in total business, becoming the first in Indian banking history to do so?

The correct answer is __**State Bank of India.**__

__
 
• The State Bank of India (SBI) has achieved a historic dual milestone by crossing $100 billion in market capitalisation and ₹100 trillion in total business, making it the first Indian bank ever to reach this scale.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• SBI’s market capitalisation crossed $100 billion following a strong rise in share price after impressive Q2 FY26 earnings.
 
• The bank’s total business, combining advances and deposits, has exceeded ₹100 trillion (₹100 lakh crore)—a first in Indian banking history.
 
• Total advances stand at approximately ₹44.2 lakh crore, while deposits total around ₹55.9 lakh crore.
 
• This milestone reflects SBI’s strong growth in retail, SME, and corporate lending and its pivotal role in India’s economic expansion.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 __

• Investor Confidence: Improved margins, stable outlook, and cost-efficiency attracted more investors.
 
 
 
• **SBI’s Market Standing**__
 __
 
• Now part of the global $100 billion market-cap club alongside Reliance Industries and TCS.
 
• Recognised as India’s largest and most systemically important public sector bank.
 
 
 
• **Static Facts**__
 __

• Headquarters: Mumbai, Maharashtra
 
• Chairman: Challa Sreenivasulu Setty
 
• Total Branches: Over 22,000 across India
 
• Status: Classified as a Domestic Systemically Important Bank (D-SIB)
 
 
 
• **Global Significance**__
 
 
• This dual milestone strengthens India’s position in the global banking ecosystem.
 
• Highlights the resilience and scalability of India’s public sector banking model.
 
• Marks SBI’s evolution into a global contender in retail and digital banking innovation.

questions.question: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated India’s first Digital Museum of Tribal Freedom Fighters at Nava Raipur, Atal Nagar. What is the official name of this museum dedicated to tribal heroes and their contribution to India’s freedom movement?

options.text: Shaheed Veer Narayan Singh Memorial and Tribal Freedom Fighters Museum

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Shaheed Veer Narayan Singh Memorial and Tribal Freedom Fighters Museum.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated India’s first Digital Museum of Tribal Freedom Fighters, named “Shaheed Veer Narayan Singh Memorial and Tribal Freedom Fighters Museum,” at Nava Raipur, Atal Nagar, Chhattisgarh.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The museum is India’s first fully digital museum dedicated to tribal heroes and freedom fighters.
 
• It features VFX displays, digital projections, QR-coded storytelling, and interactive touchscreens to create an immersive learning experience.
 
• It pays tribute to Shaheed Veer Narayan Singh (1820–1857), the first martyr of Chhattisgarh who led a revolt against British exploitation during the famine of 1856–57.
 
• The museum highlights various tribal uprisings** like the Halba Rebellion, Bhumkal Movement, and Jhanda & Jungle Satyagrahas.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **About Shaheed Veer Narayan Singh**__

 __
 
• Born: **1820** in Sonakhan, Chhattisgarh.
 
• Role: Led a peasant and tribal uprising against British grain hoarding during the famine of 1856–57.
 
• Martyrdom: Executed by the British in **1857**, becoming a symbol of tribal resistance and patriotism.
 
• Legacy: The **Veer Narayan Singh Stadium** in Raipur is named in his honour.
 
 
 
• **Major Revolts Showcased**__
 __
 
• **Halba Rebellion** – Early tribal uprising against British rule in Chhattisgarh.
 
• **Bhumkal Movement** – Revolt against British land and tax policies.
 
• **Rani Chauris Struggle** – Women-led movement against colonial oppression.
 
• **Jhanda & Jungle Satyagrahas** – Nonviolent protests for tribal rights and forest access.
 
 
 
• **Museum Significance**__
 __
 
• Combines **technology with history** to preserve tribal heritage and valor.
 
• Serves as a **hub for cultural tourism and education** in Chhattisgarh.
 
• Enhances awareness about **tribal contributions to India’s independence**.
 
 
 
• **Location Details**__
 
 
• City: **Nava Raipur, Atal Nagar**
 
• State: **Chhattisgarh**
 
• Inaugurated by: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**

questions.question: On 7 November 2025, Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the year-long commemoration of 150 years of the national song “Vande Mataram.” Who composed this iconic song that became a symbol of India’s freedom and national awakening?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Bankim Chandra Chatterji.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **On 7 November 2025, Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the 150-year commemoration of “Vande Mataram” in New Delhi, marking the song’s composition by Bankim Chandra Chatterji in 1875.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **“Vande Mataram”** was composed by **Bankim Chandra Chatterji** around **7 November 1875** on **Akshaya Navami.**
 
• The song first appeared in his novel **Anandamath**, published through the Bengali journal **Bangadarshan.**
 
• It played a major role in the **Indian freedom movement** as a call for unity and devotion to the motherland.
 
• The commemoration launch included the release of a **stamp and coin**, the digital portal **vandemataram150.in**, and a nationwide **mass singing ceremony.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Historical Background**__

 __
 
• Composed: **1875** by **Bankim Chandra Chatterji.**
 
• Published in: **Anandamath** (1882).
 
• Became a national symbol during India’s struggle for independence.
 
 
 
• **Recognition**__
 __
 
• In **1950**, President **Rajendra Prasad** declared that “Vande Mataram” should be accorded **equal honour with the national anthem** “Jana Gana Mana.”
 
 
 
• **150-Year Commemoration (2025–26)**__
 __
 
• Venue: **Indira Gandhi Indoor Stadium, New Delhi.**
 
• Key Features: **Commemorative stamp & coin**, **digital participation portal**, **mass singing event**, and **cultural concert “Vande Mataram: Naad Ekam, Roopam Anekam.”**
 
• Commemoration period: **7 Nov 2025 – 7 Nov 2026.**
 
 
 
• **Prime Minister’s Remarks**__
 __
 
• PM Modi described “Vande Mataram” as “a mantra, an energy, a dream, and a resolution.”
 
• He stated it unites all **140 crore Indians** in shared devotion to the motherland.
 
 
 
• **About Bankim Chandra Chatterji**__
 
 
• Born: **1838** in Naihati, Bengal Presidency.
 
• Major Works: **Anandamath**, **Devi Chaudhurani**, **Kapalkundala.**
 
• Known as: **“Sahitya Samrat” (Emperor of Literature)** in Bengali literature.

questions.question: Which country is President Droupadi Murmu visiting on her first-ever state visit, aimed at strengthening bilateral cooperation under the India–Africa Forum Summit (IAFS) framework?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Angola.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• President **Droupadi Murmu** is on a state visit to **Angola**, marking the **first-ever visit by an Indian President** to the country, aiming to strengthen bilateral cooperation under the **India–Africa Forum Summit (IAFS)** framework.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Angola is located on the west coast of **Southern Africa**, bordered by **Namibia**, **Zambia**, the **Democratic Republic of Congo**, and the **Atlantic Ocean**.
 
• Angola gained independence from **Portugal** in 1975, after a prolonged anti-colonial struggle.
 
• As Africa's **second-largest oil producer**, Angola has strong trade ties with India, with trade valued at over **$4 billion**.
 
• India supports Angola through **Indian Lines of Credit**, ITEC programs, and cooperation in defense training, renewable energy, and agro-industries.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Angola’s Profile**__

 __
 
• Capital: Luanda
 
• Economy: Second-largest oil producer in Africa after Nigeria; also a major diamond exporter.
 
• Geography: Roughly square-shaped, with a central plateau and major rivers like Cuanza, Cunene, and Cuango.
 
 
 
• **India-Angola Relations**__
 __
 
• Diplomatic Ties: Established in 1985, with India’s Embassy in Luanda since 1986.
 
• Trade: Over $4 billion, driven by crude oil imports and Indian exports in pharmaceuticals, textiles, machinery, and vehicles.
 
 
 
• **Cooperation Areas**__
 
 
• Defense Training: Shared expertise and collaboration on defense matters.
 
• Renewable Energy: Partnership in the development of sustainable energy solutions.
 
• Agro-industries: Joint initiatives in the agricultural sector.

questions.question: The Investor Education and Protection Fund Authority (IEPFA) in collaboration with the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) has organised the “Niveshak Shivir” in Amritsar on 1st November 2025. Under which Union Ministry does the Investor Education and Protection Fund Authority (IEPFA) function?

options.text: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Corporate Affairs.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Investor Education and Protection Fund Authority (IEPFA), under the Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Government of India, in collaboration with SEBI, organised the “Niveshak Shivir” in Amritsar on 1st November 2025.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **IEPFA functions under the administrative control of the Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA)__, Government of India.**
 
• The Niveshak Shivir in Amritsar aimed to resolve unclaimed dividend and share issues and promote investor awareness.
 
• Over 223 investors benefited from on-spot claim assistance, KYC updates, and direct access to RTAs.
 
• IEPFA also launched an explainer video to educate investors about claiming unpaid dividends through its official mechanism.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **IEPFA (Investor Education and Protection Fund Authority):**__ Established under Section 125 of the Companies Act, 2013, to protect investors and promote financial literacy.
 
• __**Functions of IEPFA:**__ Refund unclaimed dividends, matured deposits, and debentures to rightful claimants and conduct investor education programs.
 
• __**SEBI (Securities and Exchange Board of India):**__ The market regulator responsible for protecting investors and ensuring fair trade practices in the securities market.
 
• __**Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA):**__ The nodal ministry responsible for regulating corporate governance, company affairs, and investor protection in India.

questions.question: Which Indian firm has entered into a strategic pact with US-based Atomics Aeronautical Systems, Inc. to manufacture unmanned aircraft systems for the Indian Army?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Larsen & Toubro (L&T).**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Larsen & Toubro (L&T) has entered into a strategic pact with US-based Atomics Aeronautical Systems, Inc. (GA-ASI) to manufacture Medium Altitude Long Endurance (MALE) Remotely Piloted Aircraft Systems for the Indian Army.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **L&T will leverage its engineering, precision manufacturing, and system integration capabilities in defence and aerospace for this partnership.**
 
• **The pact includes manufacturing GA-ASI’s MQ-series RPAS, which are combat proven and operational globally.**
 
• **L&T will be the prime bidder for the Indian Army's 87 MALE RPAS programme, with GA-ASI as the technology partner.**
 
• **The collaboration strengthens India’s self-reliance in defence aerospace manufacturing and enhances Indo-US defence cooperation.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Larsen & Toubro (L&T)**__

 
 
• Indian multinational engaged in engineering, construction, manufacturing, and technology services.
 
• Active in defence and aerospace sectors, contributing to indigenization of critical systems.
 
• Chairman & MD: S N Subrahmanyan.
 
• Participates in high-tech projects, including unmanned aerial systems, naval platforms, and missile systems.
 
 
 
• **Atomics Aeronautical Systems, Inc. (GA-ASI)**: US firm specializing in Medium Altitude Long Endurance RPAS with millions of operational flight hours worldwide.
 
• **MALE RPAS**: Medium Altitude Long Endurance Remotely Piloted Aircraft Systems used for surveillance and strike missions.
 
• **Indo-US Defence Collaboration**: Partnership enables technology transfer, local manufacturing, and strengthens India’s defence ecosystem.
